data.name: Aidric
data.gender_notes: Aidric is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from Old English Æðelric, composed of æðel (noble) and ric (power, ruler). Aidric was a name of Anglo-Saxon and Old Norse origin, widely used among Germanic tribes. In Christian context, it can be interpreted as a divine leader, favored by God. The name Aidric carries the meaning “Ruler, leader” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Aidric usually hope their child will grow to embody ruler, leader and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbol of spiritual guidance and leadership
data.etymology: Aidric belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Ruler, leader.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aidric total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

in_hebrew.name: איידריק
in_hebrew.long_meaning: השם איידריק מורכב משתי מילים: 'עזר' ו-'אלוהים'. הוא מתורגם לעזר אלוהים או עזרה אלוהית. השם נגזר מהשפה העברית ומשמעותו הוא זה שמקבל עזרה מאלוהים או זה שנותן עזרה בשם אלוהים. איידריק הוא שם נדיר ומיוחד הנושא משמעות עמוקה ורוחנית.

in_greek.name: Αΐδρικ
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Αΐδρικ προέρχεται από την εβραϊκή γλώσσα και σημαίνει βοήθεια Θεού ή Θεοβοήθεια. Είναι ένα όνομα που φέρει πνευματική σημασία και συνδέεται με την ιδέα της θείας βοήθειας και προστασίας. Στην παράδοση των Χριστιανών, το όνομα Αΐδρικ θεωρείται σύμβολο πίστης και εμπιστοσύνης στο Θεό.

in_latin.name: Aidric
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Aidric derivatur ex lingua hebraica et significat auxilium Dei vel auxilium divinum. Est nomen quod profundam significationem spiritualem habet et refertur ad auxilium et protectionem divinam. In traditione Christiana, nomen Aidric habetur ut symbolum fidei et confidentiae in Deum.
